director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek cheez ko barabar tukdon mein baantna seekhenge, aur un tukdon ke naam. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Chalo, main batati hoon. Kitchen mein Maa ne garam roti banayi, use do bachchon mein baantna hai: dono ke tukde barabar hone chahiye. Yeh roti 2 barabar tukdon mein kati hai. Fraction mein neeche wala number saare barabar tukde ginta hai, aur upar wala rangin tukde. Ek tukda rangin hai, ek bina rang ka. Toh rangin tukde ke liye kaunsa fraction likhoge?
director.card: Ek tukda rangin hai, ek bina rang ka. Toh rangin tukde ke liye kaunsa fraction likhoge?

director.text: 1/1 sahi nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Is chocolate ke 10 barabar tukde hain, aur rangin 3 khaye gaye. Neeche wala number saare 10 ginta hai; khaane se woh ginti nahi badalti. Doosri chocolate ke rangin tukde khaye gaye. Pinky kehti hai 2/4, Golu kehta hai 2/2. Kaun sahi hai, Pinky ya Golu?
director.card: Doosri chocolate ke rangin tukde khaye gaye. Pinky kehti hai 2/4, Golu kehta hai 2/2. Kaun sahi hai, Pinky ya Golu?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, ise Hindi mein bolti hoon. Board par chocolate ke saare tukde gino, rangin bhi aur bina rang ke bhi. Phir sirf rangin tukde gino. Khaye hue tukdon ka fraction likhna hai: 2/4 theek baithta hai ya 2/2?
director.card: Khaye hue tukdon ka fraction likhna hai: 2/4 theek baithta hai ya 2/2?

seams.form: Haan, ise Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: Golu

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ek roti 8 barabar tukdon mein kati socho. Usmein se 3 kha lo ya 5, roti phir bhi 8 tukdon se hi bani thi, isliye neeche wala number 8 hi rehta hai. Upar wala number woh tukde ginta hai jinki baat ho rahi hai, yahan khaye hue. Ab tum batao.

director.text: aadha tukda

Haan, bilkul theek. Kul tukde 2, rangin 1: 1/2. Yeh pizza aur yeh cake, dono ke 3-3 tukde. Cake ke teeno tukde barabar hain, toh wahan har tukda ek-tihaai hai, 1/3. Pizza mein ek tukda bada hai aur do chhote. Pizza ka ek chhota tukda lo. Kya woh pizza ka ek-tihaai hai, haan ya nahi?

director.text: ek-tihaai nahi

Sahi jawab, kyunki tukde barabar nahi, aur chhota tukda 1/3 se chhota hai. Is circle ke 3 barabar tukde hain, ek mein rang. Yeh rangin tukda ek-tihaai hai, 1/3. Neeche wala number 3 isliye hai, kyunki poore circle ke 3 barabar tukde hain. Ek aur tukde mein rang bharo. Ab rangin tukdon ka fraction kya hoga?
director.card: Ek aur tukde mein rang bharo. Ab rangin tukdon ka fraction kya hoga?

director.text: do tihaai

Haan, sahi hai. Circle 3 barabar tukdon mein bata hai aur ab 2 mein rang hai, yaani 2/3. Is patti ka rangin tukda 1/8 hai: 8 saare tukde ginta hai, bache hue 7 nahi. Doosri patti ke 6 barabar tukde hain. Raju ne 1 tukda liya, 5 bache. Raju kehta hai usne 1/5 liya, kyunki 5 bache. Raju ne asal mein kaunsa fraction liya?

director.text: 1/5 sahi nahi hai. 1/5 hota toh aise sirf 5 tukde poori patti bana dete; par patti mein bache 5 ke saath Raju ka tukda bhi tha, toh Raju ne sirf bache hue gine. 6 barabar tukdon wali patti se Raju ne 1 tukda kaata aur 5 bache, toh Raju ne patti ka kaunsa fraction liya?

Kaatne se pehle doosri patti mein kitne barabar tukde the, gino. Phir socho ki Raju ka tukda unmein se ek tha ya bache 5 mein se. Aaram se socho, phir batao.

Bilkul sahi: Raju ne 6 barabar tukdon wali patti se ek tukda liya, toh 1/6; bache hue 5 tukde naam nahi badalte. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Ek lambi barfi ke 5 barabar tukde kiye, aur 3 tukde kha liye. Is baar rangin tukde woh hain jo plate par bache. Plate par bache tukdon ke fraction mein neeche wala number kya hoga?

director.text: paanch tukde
Haan, 5: barfi 5 barabar tukdon mein kati thi. Tumhari baari: plate par bache tukde poori barfi ka kaunsa fraction hain?

director.text: two fifths

Haan, bilkul theek. Toh poora jawab: bache hue tukde barfi ka 2/5 hain, kyunki 5 barabar tukdon mein se 2 bache; neeche wala number 5 hai, saare tukde, khaye hue 3 nahi. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Laddoo toota aur 3 tukde ho gaye, ek bada aur do chhote. Board par dekho: bada tukda laddoo ka 1/2 hai ya 1/3?

Sahi jawab. Laddoo ke 3 tukdon mein bada tukda theek aadha hai, yaani 1/2; dono chhote milkar baaki aadha. Tumhari chocolate ke 12 barabar tukde hain. Tumne usmein se 1/12 kha liya. Ab kitne tukde bache?

director.text: 9 sahi nahi hai. Socho, 1/12 ka neeche wala number kya ginta hai, aur upar wala kya ginta hai. 12 barabar tukdon wali chocolate ka 1/12 khaya gaya, toh kitne tukde bache?
director.card: Tumhari chocolate ke 12 barabar tukde hain. Tumne usmein se 1/12 kha liya. Ab kitne tukde bache?

director.text: 11 bache

Bilkul sahi: 1/12 matlab 12 barabar tukdon wali chocolate ka ek tukda khaya; 12 mein se 1 gaya, toh 11 bache. Cake ke 4 tukde hue: ek bada aur teen ek jitne chhote. Ek chhota tukda cake ke 1/4 se kam hai, 1/4 ke barabar hai, ya 1/4 se zyada?
director.card: Cake ke 4 tukde hue: ek bada aur teen ek jitne chhote. Ek chhota tukda cake ke 1/4 se kam hai, 1/4 ke barabar hai, ya 1/4 se zyada?

director.text: less than 1/4

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki chaaron tukde milkar poora cake hain; teen chhote barabar hain aur bada unse bada, toh har chhota tukda 1/4 se kam. Ab ek cheez ki jagah bahut saari cheezein lenge, jaise laddoo, aam ya kanche, aur unka fraction nikalenge. Niyam wahi rahega: sab barabar. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
thak gayi, bye
Thakaan ho toh aaram karna bilkul theek hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
